reading.title: Stations and Expansions Under Scorpio Sun
overview: The Sun stands at 21° Scorpio while the Moon at 12° Capricorn moves out of bounds and applies to a sextile with the Sun. Mercury stations retrograde at 5° Scorpio and Venus stations direct at 23° Libra in its rulership. Mars at 25° Leo conjoins Jupiter at 26° Leo, Uranus at 4° Gemini retrograde trines Pluto at 3° Aquarius out of bounds, and Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextiles Pluto.

Mundane tradition associates the Mars-Jupiter conjunction with expansionist campaigns and overreach, the Uranus-Pluto trine with revolution and upheaval, and the Neptune-Pluto sextile with slow shifts in collective beliefs. The recent Scorpio new moon at 17° falls in the third house for the United States and the twelfth house for Russia, Ukraine and Israel, with Mars placed in the twelfth for the US and the ninth for the others.
Transits to national angles remain within the stated two-degree limit for the listed charts. The next lunation and planetary stations fall after 22 November.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC within one degree while Jupiter opposes the natal Moon and Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. These positions coincide with reported leads on naval warnings and GDELT hotspots but show no confirmed IRGC damage or Hormuz incident in the supplied record.

Transiting Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Neptune sextiles it while Jupiter conjoins natal Jupiter and Mercury. The Mars-Jupiter conjunction appears in the supplied record alongside a confirmed Ukrainian strike on Naro-Fominsk.

Transiting Pluto opposes natal Moon and Uranus sextiles it while Mars squares natal Sun. The record notes an opinion piece on Netanyahu's isolation but supplies no direct tie to the listed aspects beyond the given z-score.

Transiting Saturn squares natal Sun and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter while Jupiter squares natal Venus. The Uranus-Pluto and Uranus-Neptune aspects appear alongside prediction-market questions on the 2026 local elections for DPP and KMT.

reading.lore_and_intel: The Mars-Jupiter conjunction overlaps with the reported Ukrainian strike and a Texas cyberattack warning at z 4.0 and z 2.6; the Uranus-Pluto trine and Uranus-Neptune sextile overlap with Taiwan election markets at z values above 3.5; the Venus-Mars and Sun-Mars aspects overlap with US-Iran energy warnings and PLA activity near Taiwan at z 3.9 and z 4.4. No overlap appears for the Moon-Saturn square or the Saturn-Neptune conjunction with any listed item, and the fair-test results apply uniformly across all claims.

reading.the_test: The records show Mars afflicted versus Ukraine air-raid alarms no better than chance at -1% over 1685 days. Mars afflicted versus Israel alerts, Russian losses, and retrograde effects likewise register no better than chance across thousands of days, as do full moons, new moons and eclipses versus the same events and worldwide magnitude-6 earthquakes.
